text:
Plate diameter is roughly 400 px in the image. If it is a dinner plate of about 26 cm, that is about 15 px per cm.

The food is roasted broccoli, probably broccolini or rabe, with a small patty-like item that could be a piece of meat or a fritter. The patty is partly hidden at about 80 px, or about 5 cm.

The broccoli covers an area of about 200 by 130 px, which is roughly 13 by 9 cm. It is a thin layer, so I estimate about 100 g. It looks oily and charred, which adds some calories. I put it at about 90 kcal.

The patty is about 8 cm across and 1 cm thick, so I estimate about 60 g. At about 200 kcal per 100 g, that is about 120 kcal.

Total mass is about 160 g and total energy is about 210 kcal.
